metadata.title: Marvell's CEO Calls It the Switzerland of the AI Market

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Marvell Technology Inc. (NASDAQ:MRVL) rose 4.33% intraday after CEO Matt Murphy told CNBC's Mad Money that the company's position with hyperscale customers rests on a decade of relationship building. "In this market, these large hyperscale customers and the ecosystem around it, it's really based on trust," he said, describing trust that suppliers can deliver increasingly complex chips on time and at scale.
Murphy laid out what a customer is actually asking. Can the engineering team deliver the chip. Can management be relied on to shoot straight. Will the capacity and supply hold. And can you trust the CEO. Murphy said that standing lets Marvell supply custom silicon to every major US hyperscaler while selling optical connectivity across the industry, which keeps it from depending on one buyer or one architecture. He called Marvell "the Switzerland of this entire market right now," a company that works with everybody.
Those relationships feed the growth. Data center revenue is projected to rise 60% in fiscal 2027 and 61% in fiscal 2028, according to FactSet data cited by CNBC. Marvell shares have increased over 250% over the past year.
